The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] '''Shotem''' was the mining site for specialized [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystals]] which pulsed and caused the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to be more powerful. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] of the planet were known to wear visors, robes, gloves, and boots which were unique to the planet in addition to using a different type of lightsaber hilt to that of other Jedi.
